levels.name: Street and platform level (new station building / station hall, platforms)
levels.note: New station building (architect Anssi Lassila / OOPEAA) opened 4 Dec 2024; the station hall is part of an office and business building with the family centre and a 450-space parking house (P-Asema) joined directly to the hall. Bus and taxi users enter at street level. The 1971 station building still stands; its future is undecided.

open: Platform numbering: VR names platforms 1–3 (1 and 2 raised); Digitraffic has tracks 1–4 with only L1 'korkea' (L2–L4 'matala'), and the laser gives L2 ≈0.52 m above rail. How tracks 2–4 map onto platforms 2 and 3, and where track 4's platform is, is unsettled.
Café Picnic and Food & Co Bistro Kaffeli hours not found; R-Kioski hours are OSM only.
Bus links: VR ('no public transport connections') vs OOPEAA (local buses on Valtionkatu, long-distance buses north of the old station).
No signposted level names; no heights.

answers.question: Which platforms have stairs/lifts?
answers.answer: Per OSM: two underpasses, each with a lift and stairs to platform 1 (track 1) and to the island platform for tracks 2–3. The newest (by the new station building, finished Feb 2025) is confirmed by the architect's text; per-platform lifts are OSM only. VR: platforms 1 and 2 are raised, platforms 1–3 have canopies.
answers._source: OOPEAA 'The New Seinäjoki Station is Inaugurated', https://oopeaa.com/?p=14694, read 2026-10-30; VR 'Seinäjoki' station page, https://www.vr.fi/rautatieasemat-ja-reitit/seinajoki, read 2026-10-30; OpenStreetMap (osmfacts extract /home/claude/osmfacts_fi/FI-SK.json), read 2026-10-30
